Mr. Amarjit Markan, Advocate for respondent No. 2 Avneesh
Jhingan (Oral):
1.

This petition is filed for grant of anticipatory bail in Fir No. 23 dated 8.6.2023,
under Sections 420, 120-B Ipc, registered at Police Station City Ahmedgarh, District
Malerkotla.

2. This Court vide order dated 24.7.2023, granted the interim bail subject to joining
investigation.
3.  Learned State Counsel, on instructions from SI-Sukhwinder Singh submits that the petitioners have joined the investigation and are co- operating.
4. Learned counsel for respondent No. 2 vehemently opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.
